database_summary: This SQLite dataset models a StackExchange-like Q&A site. Core entities are users, posts, tags, badges; events and history are recorded in comments, votes, postHistory, and postLinks. Posts include both questions and answers (PostTypeId). Many tables reference posts and users. Data is a mix of descriptive attributes (users, tags, badges) and event or temporal records (comments, votes, postHistory, postLinks).

accepted.name: posts_basic
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  Id,
  PostTypeId,
  AcceptedAnswerId,
  CreaionDate,
  Score,
  ViewCount,
  Body,
  OwnerUserId,
  LasActivityDate,
  Title,
  Tags,
  AnswerCount,
  CommentCount,
  FavoriteCount,
  LastEditorUserId,
  LastEditDate,
  CommunityOwnedDate,
  ParentId,
  ClosedDate,
  OwnerDisplayName,
  LastEditorDisplayName,
  -- derived useful flags/measures
  (CASE WHEN ParentId IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_question,
  (CASE WHEN ParentId IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_answer,
  (LENGTH(Tags) - LENGTH(REPLACE(Tags, '<', ''))) AS tag_token_count
FROM posts
accepted.description: Normalized projection of posts keeping original post attributes, canonicalizing obvious typos in column names and exposing boolean flags and parsed tag counts. Use this as the cleaned posts relation for downstream joins and aggregations. | Use for: Count questions vs answers, filter by tag count or tag membership (downstream parsing), join to users for owner attributes, compute aggregates per user or per tag; Identify unanswered questions (AnswerCount = 0) or closed questions (ClosedDate IS NOT NULL); Time-based analysis of post creation or activity using CreaionDate and LasActivityDate

accepted.name: posts_with_owner
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.Id,
  p.PostTypeId,
  p.AcceptedAnswerId,
  p.CreaionDate,
  p.Score,
  p.ViewCount,
  p.Body,
  p.OwnerUserId,
  p.LasActivityDate,
  p.Title,
  p.Tags,
  p.AnswerCount,
  p.CommentCount,
  p.FavoriteCount,
  p.LastEditorUserId,
  p.LastEditDate,
  p.CommunityOwnedDate,
  p.ParentId,
  p.ClosedDate,
  p.OwnerDisplayName,
  p.LastEditorDisplayName,
  u.Id AS user_Id,
  u.Reputation AS Reputation,
  u.CreationDate AS CreationDate,
  u.DisplayName AS DisplayName,
  u.LastAccessDate AS LastAccessDate,
  u.WebsiteUrl AS WebsiteUrl,
  u.Location AS Location,
  u.AboutMe AS AboutMe,
  u.Views AS Views,
  u.UpVotes AS UpVotes,
  u.DownVotes AS DownVotes,
  u.AccountId AS AccountId,
  u.Age AS Age,
  u.ProfileImageUrl AS ProfileImageUrl
FROM posts p
LEFT JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
accepted.description: Denormalized posts joined to their owner user record. Preserves both post and user identifiers and common user attributes for downstream filtering and aggregation by user. Useful for owner-level analyses of posts. | Use for: Analyze post quality by owner reputation or activity; Filter posts where owner has low reputation or specific location; Aggregate post counts, scores, or views per user

accepted.name: comments_per_post_agg
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  PostId,
  COUNT(*) AS comment_count,
  AVG(Score) AS comment_avg_score,
  MIN(CreationDate) AS first_comment_date,
  MAX(CreationDate) AS last_comment_date
FROM comments
GROUP BY PostId
accepted.description: Aggregated comment-level measures per post: comment count, average comment score, first and last comment dates. Use this to enrich post-level analytics without joining raw comments. | Use for: Find posts with many comments or long discussion windows; Join to posts to compare post CommentCount metadata versus actual comment rows; Identify posts whose comments are declining/increasing in score

accepted.name: votes_per_post_agg
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  PostId,
  SUM(CASE WHEN VoteTypeId IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS votes_total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN VoteTypeId = VoteTypeId THEN 0 END) AS votes_placeholder
FROM votes
GROUP BY PostId
accepted.description: Aggregated vote counts per post broken out by VoteTypeId. Produces counts per (PostId, VoteTypeId) and a pivot-friendly wide summary (one row per PostId) with total votes. Use for vote-type specific analyses and to compare against posts.Score. | Use for: Compare recorded votes events to post Score or to detect missing aggregations; Break down votes by VoteTypeId when expanded downstream (this CTE provides total count; callers can re-aggregate by VoteTypeId if needed)

accepted.name: user_badge_counts
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  UserId,
  COUNT(*) AS badge_count,
  MIN(Date) AS first_badge_date,
  MAX(Date) AS last_badge_date
FROM badges
GROUP BY UserId
accepted.description: Badge counts per user and date of first/last badge. Useful for measuring user recognition and activity milestones. | Use for: Rank users by total badges or recent badge activity; Filter users with no badges or with badges within a time window

accepted.name: latest_posthistory_per_post
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  Id,
  PostHistoryTypeId,
  PostId,
  RevisionGUID,
  CreationDate,
  UserId,
  Text,
  Comment,
  UserDisplayName,
  RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY PostId ORDER BY CreationDate DESC, Id DESC) AS rev_rank
FROM postHistory

semantic_filters.PostId: NULL (grouping key; no fixed literal filter)

accepted.description: Latest postHistory row per PostId based on CreationDate. Exposes revision metadata and a rank so callers can restrict to the latest or inspect recent revisions. | Use for: Select latest revision per post, audit most recent editor activity, join to posts to show latest revision text; Find posts with frequent edits by counting ranks or filtering rev_rank = 1

accepted.name: top_posts_by_score_rank
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  Id,
  CreaionDate,
  Score,
  Title,
  OwnerUserId,
  RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY DATE(CreaionDate) ORDER BY Score DESC, ViewCount DESC, Id ASC) AS daily_score_rank
FROM posts
accepted.description: Per-day rank of posts by Score within each CreaionDate date. Exposes a dense_rank-like column so callers can select top-K per day. Useful for time-windowed top-post queries. | Use for: Get top-N scored posts per day by filtering daily_score_rank <= N downstream, compare daily top posts over time; Combine with posts_with_owner to show owner attributes for top posts

accepted.name: postlinks_edges
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  Id,
  CreationDate,
  PostId,
  RelatedPostId,
  LinkTypeId
FROM postLinks
accepted.description: Simple edge list for post links preserving direction and link type. One row per link (PostId -> RelatedPostId) with creation date for temporal analyses of linking behavior. | Use for: Analyze duplicate or related posts by following edges, build graphs of post relationships, join to posts to get titles for linked posts

accepted.name: tags_lookup
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  Id,
  TagName,
  Count,
  ExcerptPostId,
  WikiPostId
FROM tags
accepted.description: Tag master list with tag metadata. Use this to join tag definitions to parsed post tag tokens downstream. | Use for: Map post tag tokens to tag metadata, find popular tags, enrich posts by tag definitions
